# Narrumo Android downloads

The current signed release is **2.1.0 / build 17**:

- [ARM64 APK](https://morrow-audio.aptnote8.chatgpt.site/download.html?arch=arm64&version=2.1.0) — 59,665,542 bytes
- [ARM32 APK](https://morrow-audio.aptnote8.chatgpt.site/download.html?arch=arm32&version=2.1.0) — 58,481,806 bytes

Fresh installs offer optional local Whisper setup and short, skippable spotlight tours. Existing installations retain their library and setup. Replay from Settings → Replay quick tour, or Book options → Listening screen tour. Settings → Local speech setup offers the same verified download later. Book options and removal confirmation use Narrumo’s warm paper sheets; removing a book keeps the original audio.

Fast English recognition remains bundled. Accurate recognition uses a separate, confirmed, SHA-256-verified Whisper base.en download of about 60 MB. After setup it runs locally with no transcription API charge or audio upload; names can still need corrections. Online chapter recaps and illustrations remain separate, explicitly confirmed AI actions with shared test allowances. Saved text, pictures, progress and private connection settings are preserved during an update.

SHA-256 files sit alongside this document. Both APKs use the existing release certificate and install over previous Morrow/Narrumo versions. The download page prepares and SHA-256 verifies a normal APK in your browser before saving. Never commit signing credentials.

Older generic APKs retained here are historical 1.4.1 downloads (and Morrow 1.4.0). Use the website for the current version.
